meta.title: Double‑click on "Master QCS" does not duplicate ranking view
gaps: Performing a rapid double-click gesture on the Master QCS tab
Directly asserting that no duplicate ranking panels were created
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Performing a rapid double-click gesture on the Master QCS tab; Directly asserting that no duplicate ranking panels were created

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ's Master QCS view with its submitted bid.
Activate the Master QCS tab once.
Repeat the tab activation as the closest available representation of the requested double-click.
Verify that the QCS contains only the single expected vendor column with a real vendor name.
Verify that ranking data remains present and valid after the repeated activation.
Check that no rendering errors, duplicate-related crash, or malformed ranking content appears.
